run_detectron2_training_on_coco_dataset: run detectron2 mask r-cnn training on a COCO instance segmentation dataset with configurable learning rate and iterations
run_evaluation_on_test_jsons: run evaluation on multiple test JSON subsets and collect average AP50 scores for bbox and segmentation
create_custom_train_loader_with_augmenta: create a custom detectron2 train loader with resize, flip, crop, and brightness augmentations
submit_slurm_jobs_with_submitit: submit batched SLURM training jobs using submitit AutoExecutor with configurable GPU and memory parameters
write_training_results_to_log_file: write bounding box and segmentation AP50 results to a summary log file for analysis
